name: YouTube Community Post
strategic_objective: Lightweight touchpoints between uploads: updates, conversation starters, and quick engagement with subscribers.

tone: Conversational, concise, and creator-like. Feels direct and personal, not like a formal announcement.
copywriting_rules: Keep posts short and focused on a single idea. Use questions, prompts, or simple updates to drive comments and reactions. Avoid long paragraphs; community posts should be scannable.
Line 1: core update or question. Optional line 2–3: short context or detail. Final line: simple CTA to comment, vote, or watch something.
Community posts are not primarily discovery tools; use hashtags sparingly.
Mention collaborators or channels when cross-promoting content.

required_generation_elements: At least one question or CTA for engagement
hard_constraints: Posting only promotional links with no context
Multiple unrelated ideas in one post
Overposting to the point of feed fatigue
